c.tagline: Central Java's soulful royal city of palaces, batik, and Javanese tradition.

taxi.fareNote: Blue Bird operates metered taxis; insist on the meter, or use Gojek/Grab for fixed up-front car and motorbike pricing. Traditional becak cycle-rickshaws are negotiated before the ride.

emergency.note: 112 is the general nationwide emergency line; 110 reaches police and 113 the fire service.

avoid.reason: Watch for pickpockets in Pasar Klewer and Pasar Gede market crowds; otherwise usual city awareness.

hood_desc: The historic royal core around the Kraton Surakarta Hadiningrat palace, the Great Mosque and the Kauman batik quarter; the cultural heart, best for sightseeing and tradition on foot.
A centuries-old batik-making village of walled merchant mansions and workshops where you can watch and buy hand-drawn batik; best for batik shopping and heritage lanes.
The main boulevard of Jalan Slamet Riyadi, the city's central artery lined with malls, cafes, hotels and the Sunday car-free market; a convenient, well-connected base in the middle of everything.
A quieter eastern district around Sebelas Maret University (UNS) and the leafy Balekambang park; residential and local, good for a calmer, cheaper stay.
The area around the Pura Mangkunegaran palace and the Ngarsopuro/Pasar Triwindu antique market and night market; best for a mix of royal sights and browsing for crafts and antiques.
lodging: The Royal Surakarta Heritage Solo - MGallery

water.note: Drink bottled or boiled water only.

transit.hours: Batik Solo Trans corridor buses and feeder minibuses run roughly 5:30 AM to 8:00 PM; becak (cycle-rickshaws) and Gojek/Grab cover shorter and later trips.
transit.note: Solo is compact and flat: the Batik Solo Trans (BST) bus rapid transit runs several corridors across the city, supplemented by traditional becak cycle-rickshaws, angkot, the KA Commuter Solo-Yogyakarta line from Solo Balapan, and Gojek/Grab.
transit.pay: BST fares are paid in cash or by e-money card on board (about Rp 3,700, cheaper for students, Rp 7,000 to/from the airport); becak fares are negotiated before the ride; ride-hailing apps use in-app payment or QRIS.

bus: Intercity buses from Tirtonadi Terminal to Yogyakarta, Semarang, Surabaya and across Java

car.idp: Recommended (International Driving Permit required alongside home license)

train: Solo Balapan & Solo Jebres intercity trains to Jakarta, Surabaya and across Java

transit.m: Batik Solo Trans / airport bus to the city (~40 min, ~Rp 7,000)
Adisumarmo Airport Rail Link to Solo Balapan station (~15 min)
Airport taxi to central Solo (25-35 min)

tip.r: Not obligatory; a service charge is often included at larger restaurants and hotels, and rounding up or leaving small change for good service is appreciated but not expected.
